name: Form 3 Business Studies: The Ledger
subject: Business Studies
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to post transactions to the ledger
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to balance a ledger account
learningActivities: Revision: learners recall the accounting equation
Demonstration: teacher posts transactions to ledger accounts
Guided practice: learners post simple transactions
Independent work: learners balance ledger accounts
keyPoints: The ledger is the main book of account
Every transaction affects at least two accounts (double entry)
The difference between the debit and credit sides is the balance
commonMisconceptions: Posting to the wrong side of the account
Forgetting that every debit must have a corresponding credit
lessonEvaluation: Learners post transactions and balance a ledger account. Teacher checks work.
teacherReflection: Most learners posted correctly. More practice on balancing next lesson.
